description: Defines a Pydantic model 'FileMetadata' representing metadata for uploaded files and a helper function 'metadata_from_upload' to create such metadata objects.

classes.name: FileMetadata
classes.description: Data model representing metadata details of an uploaded file, including filename, content_type, size, upload_time, and optional path.

methods.name: FileMetadata metadata_from_upload(filename: str, content_type: str, size: int, upload_time: datetime.datetime, path: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a 'FileMetadata' object from upload attributes, formatting the upload_time to ISO8601 string with UTC timezone.

ctags.name: content_type
ctags.pattern: /^    content_type: str = Field(..., description="MIME type detected for the file")$/

ctags.name: filename
ctags.pattern: /^    filename: str = Field(..., description="Original name of the uploaded file")$/

ctags.name: metadata_from_upload
ctags.pattern: /^def metadata_from_upload(filename: str, content_type: str, size: int, upload_time: datetime.date/
ctags.signature: (filename: str, content_type: str, size: int, upload_time: datetime.datetime, path: str = None)

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^    path: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Path where the file is stored on server")$/

ctags.name: size
ctags.pattern: /^    size: int = Field(..., description="Byte size of the uploaded file")$/

ctags.name: upload_time
ctags.pattern: /^    upload_time: str = Field(..., description="UTC ISO8601 upload time")$/
